finalText:

- `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9,13` — still on `db.query`. File header says "Vendored copy of legacy-orm 2.1.4. Do not edit — replaced wholesale on every upgrade, local changes silently lost." Editing gets wiped next upgrade. Needs upstream fix or a wrapper at import site. Your call — say word and me add shim.
- `cache.query(...)` hits in ~20 repo files — different object (`lib/cache.js`), not part of this migration.
